voice.summary: Sunday Supper sounds like a host who really does want to know how the evening went. The voice is cheerful, short and food-first, and never defensive about a bad night.
dos: Ask about the meal, not the service desk
Thank people for criticism as much as praise
donts: Get defensive about a low score
Make people type more than they want to

taglines: Good food deserves a good word
boilerplate: Sunday Supper is a neighbourhood restaurant that asks every guest how the meal felt, then reads each reply to improve the cooking and the welcome.

microcopy.success: Thank you. We read every note.
microcopy.error: That did not send. Please try again.
microcopy.empty: No notes yet. Tell us how it was.

logo.note: A little house keeps the supper-at-home feeling the name promises.
